jobs.title: 分析师助理岗（2027届，周期组）
jobs.description:
职责描述:
1、参与行业日报、周报撰写及基础数据跟踪及分析等日常工作；
2、参与研究相关课题、深度报告的撰写工作。参与调研、电话调研等工作，进行会议纪要的整理等工作；
3、参与证券研究所相关培训，学习行研基础技能及行业/企业基本面分析方法。

任职资格:
1、硕士研究生及以上学历，金融、经管类、理工类相关专业优先；
2、勤奋自驱，具备较强的成就动机与抗压能力，乐于从事挑战性工作；
3、具备良好的逻辑思维能力、沟通表达能力，文字功底扎实；
4、有券商行研实习经验者优先。

截止日期：2026年10月31日
招聘人数：2人

extractionNotes.publicTextExcerpt:
UFLP in Human Resources

As we receive a high volume of applications, please make sure to read the job description below carefully and apply for the ONE function you are most interested in. Only your first application will be considered.

About Unilever

Unilever is one of the world's leading FMCG companies, home to iconic brands including Dove, Vaseline, TRESemmé, Lynx, Persil, Domestos, Surf, Radox, Sure and Liquid I.V. Through products used by millions of people every day, we help improve health, wellbeing, confidence and care around the world.

Established over 100 years ago, Unilever has a proud heritage of innovation and a long-standing belief that great brands, great people and responsible business go hand in hand.

Today, we are transforming into a faster, more focused growth company centred on Beauty & Wellbeing, Personal Care and Home Care. Through world-class brands, cutting-edge science and technology, digital innovation and AI-enabled capabilities, we are building unmissably superior products and experiences for consumers around the world.

A career at Unilever offers the opportunity to work at global scale while helping shape the future of some of the world's most recognised brands. Our people are at the heart of everything we do, bringing curiosity, creativity and passion to solve real business challenges and make a meaningful impact every day.

 What do we look for? 

We are looking for future HR leaders who are motivated by a passion for people and are trusted partners in the business to get things done. We need people who can drive performance by using data and insight to inform decision-making and continually think of new ways of doing things, fuelled by their dissatisfaction with the status quo. Whilst people skills are critical for the Unilever Futures Programme in HR, there are no specific qualifications necessary.  We need HR people who are mindful and responsive to contexts and audiences, inspired to develop colleagues and the capabilities required for our winning business.  

The role of HR in Unilever as a core strategic business area means we look for people with enthusiasm, an interest in how businesses operate, and the bravery to offer creative insights and execute change. People who can build relationships, collaborate with others, have a data-driven mindset, and possess strong influencing and negotiation abilities.
